C0185.title: Li Sentenced for Profiting Over 30,000 Yuan by Removing Negative Reviews for a Fee
C0185.summary: In September 2025, the Enshi Municipal People's Court in Hubei Province tried a case involving illegally obtaining computer information system data to remove negative reviews for a fee. The defendant Li illegally intruded into the platform's system using technical means to delete negative reviews for merchants, profiting over 30,000 yuan. His actions constituted a crime and he was sentenced.
